positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
▪ Designed, implemented, and tested a self-serve reset option in JavaScript to allow Shopify merchants to restart catalog integration and feed ingestion, resulting in a decrease in customer tickets
▪ Coordinated with UX, Customer Ops, and Shopify teams to design look and functionality of reset
▪ Monitored and analyzed results for an experiment for the reset functionality

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
▪ Enhanced user experience for the new Pinterest Configuration System by designing and implementing two Cobra command line tools that were deployed to all non-production devapps at Pinterest 
▪ Created new APIs in the Distribution Agent to gather information about a user’s service host, which were called on by the first tool based on user inputs
▪ Modified the existing config update process in the Distribution Agent and added new functionality to support local config overrides, which were created by the second tool
▪ Required extensive knowledge of Go, filesystem manipulation, concurrency, and git.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description:
▪ Worked with 8 team members on the Non-Profit Portal (web application), which will help facilitate communication between outside organizations looking to start a project with Bits of Good
▪ Implemented database schemas and MongoDB actions in TypeScript to setup backend functionality
▪ Constructed Project Application Page and Sidebar Component in React.js based on our designers’ layout

▪ Worked on a React web app with 6 team members to help manage contact between utility companies, applicants, and AccessH2O (client)
▪ Implemented database schemas and MongoDB actions in TypeScript to setup backend functionality
▪ Implemented the Client Application Form and Admin functionalities to edit this form if criteria for applications change.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
▪ Automated the manual calculation process of the Alexa ML Adoption metric, which organized data collecting for the team’s main project (MLWatch) 
▪ Utilized AWS Lambda to run queries for the metric, AWS S3 to store query/metric results, and an AWS step function to organize the entire workflow
▪ Collaborated with other engineers and managers to ensure successful, on-time deliverance of 100 % of the project
▪ Documented and presented final product to 3 Alexa teams to prepare for transfer of ownership of project
positions.insights: Skills: AWS Lambda · AWS Step Functions · Python

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
▪ Streamlined lab management by implementing a web application where students and advisors can complete tasks like request new supplies, monitor sensitive gauges, or view upcoming deadlines
▪ Coordinated with head lab advisor to design initial mockups for 10 of the 16 pages on the platform
▪ Implemented end-to-end functionality (React/Django) for inventory management, supply requests, and admin services  
▪ Lead beta testing and deployment to production accounts for a team of 6 developers and 3 advisors
▪ Compiled learning materials (background knowledge & platform details) for onboarding new team members
▪ Worked with Slack API, Mailjet API, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Django, Python, React, JavaScript, and CSS
positions.insights: Skills: Django · React.js · Team Leadership · Web Design

volunteerExperiences.description: Package food and toiletry items for distribution to other non-profit organizations and churches.

We conduct science experiments with the Burgess-Peterson Academy and Scott Elementary After-School Programs once a week. With each experiment, we try to teach the students small science concepts like what catalysts, acids, and bases are. Our goal is to not only spark an interest in STEM for these students, but also to just be there for them. Little Einsten's is about education, but it is also about community and bringing people together. We teach them about science and they keep us in touch with our childhood.
